question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4.
solution:
The correct answer is "**little**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Little" is the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4.** 
 
• "Little" means small in size, amount, or degree.(थोड़ा)
 
 
• Example: She has very little experience of such issues.
 
 
 
• **In this context, the speaker is referring to the amount of sunlight that moon reflects, hence "little" fits perfectly.**
 
• Grammatically, "little" is an adjective that modifies the noun that comes after it.

Hence, the correct answer is option 4.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1, "minute", means extremely small or insignificant. It could also refer to a unit of time.(बहुत छोटा)
 
• **Option 2, "less", means a smaller amount or degree of something. (कम)**
 
• Option 3, "petty", means of little importance or significance, often referring to small or trivial matters.(तुच्छ)
